note: Eleventh Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation, signed June 14, 2021. The caption and recital name the corporation JAND, Inc., but the restated text (Article I) renames it Warby Parker Inc. — a Company Name attribute that must be resolved from the document itself. Explicit Subchapter XV election, balancing clause, and specific public benefit purpose. Exercises Amendment Supermajority Requirements = 'No' on the narrow form A5 says does not count: the Preferred protective provisions restrict amendments only when they 'adversely alter or change the powers, preferences or special rights' of the Preferred Stock, and Article XI is only the statutory reservation of the right to amend.
